company.name: Tenable
company.shortDescription: Tenable provides an exposure management platform to identify and mitigate risks.
company.description: Tenable is a cybersecurity company that offers an exposure management platform designed to identify and close security gaps across IT, cloud, and operational technology environments. The platform unifies security visibility and insight, enabling organizations to manage vulnerabilities effectively and reduce business risk.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered platform that unifies asset inventory, exposure intelligence, attack-path analysis, risk prioritization, remediation orchestration and reporting across cloud, IT, OT, identity and AI environments.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable One Exposure Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A cloud security platform that provides visibility, risk analysis and remediation for multi-cloud and hybrid environments, including cloud workloads, identities, data, containers, Kubernetes, AI resources and infrastructure as code.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable Cloud Security

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based vulnerability management platform that continuously discovers and tracks assets, assesses vulnerabilities, adds risk context, prioritizes remediation and provides reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable Vulnerability Management

productsAndServices.description: A vulnerability assessment scanner for identifying security weaknesses, configuration issues and compliance gaps across IT environments through automated scanning and policy-based audits.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable Nessus

productsAndServices.description: A security solution for converged operational technology and IT environments that discovers assets, identifies security blind spots and prioritizes high-risk exposures.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable OT Security

productsAndServices.description: An identity security solution that assesses Active Directory, hybrid identity and Entra ID environments to identify privileged-identity weaknesses and prioritize identity-based attack paths.
productsAndServices.name: Tenable Identity Exposure
